Epic Official Account

Not connected.

Xbox PC (Microsoft / Xbox Network)

Not connected.
Sign in with the Microsoft account used by the Xbox app. Authentication and Xbox Network tokens are stored encrypted; your Microsoft password is never stored. This direct Xbox OAuth route is experimental and can be restricted by Microsoft.

RetroAchievements

Not connected.
Uses the read-only RetroAchievements Web API. The API key is stored encrypted. Notifications are checked only while a RetroAchievements config is selected.

Backup & Restore

Move your complete Achievements profile to another installation.

Export Profile Backup

Saves configs, achievement cache, covers, images, presets, sounds, themes, playtime, preferences, and dashboard data.

The backup is not encrypted and can contain sensitive settings, including your Steam Web API key. Store it securely.

Encrypted account token files are not exported. Connected services may require sign-in again after restore.

Restore Profile Backup

Replaces the current profile and restarts Achievements. Missing save paths do not prevent restored cache data from being shown.

Platform & Emulator Guide

This guide explains what to watch, how auto-config starts, and when notifications are generated for each platform.

  • Add root folders in Settings → Folders.
  • Auto-config runs only for watched folders that are not muted/ignored.
  • Notifications are sent only on new unlock/progress changes, not for already imported old unlocks.
Steam / Epic / GOG / Uplay
  • Core flow: watch save/achievement files (for example achievements.json, achievements.ini, stats.bin, user_stats.ini) inside configured roots.
  • Manual config: set a valid AppID and correct Achievements Save Path.
  • Uplay note: if Steam mapping is needed, use the mapped Steam AppID field when available.
  • Epic emu method (Nemirtingas): if NemirtingasEpicEmu is used, the scanner discovers numeric AppIDs from user subfolders and treats them as Epic candidates.
  • GOG method 1 (preferred): detect goggame-*.info files and read game IDs from those files.
  • GOG method 2 (fallback): detect UniverseLAN.ini and read GameSettings.AppID; runtime progress is monitored from UniverseLANData\\Achievements.ini.
  • TENOKE method: detect tenoke.ini and read id=APPID.
  • TENOKE runtime: after config creation, watcher searches deeper for user_stats.ini (including SteamData\\user_stats.ini), updates save_path, and relinks automatically.
  • GOG can also run with manual config using a valid AppID and Platform = GOG, even without .info or UniverseLAN.ini.
  • If only numeric folders are present, auto mode may classify by heuristics; for strict GOG behavior, keep goggame-*.info/UniverseLAN.ini or set platform manually.
Epic Official
  • Login and import flow: connect an Epic account in Settings to import owned games as `epic-official` configs.
  • Local detection uses Epic manifest files to resolve install location, executable path and process name when available.
  • No manual creation from the platform dropdown: configs are auto-generated.
  • Polling runs for the detected running Epic game, or for an Epic Official config explicitly selected by the user.
Steam (Official)
  • Watch folder: Steam\appcache\stats.
  • Detection is based on UserGameStatsSchema_*.bin files.
  • If schema/progress seems outdated, use folder rescan instead of manual schema regeneration.
Xbox PC (Microsoft / Xbox Network)
  • Select Connect Xbox, sign in to the Microsoft account used by the Xbox app, then use Import Xbox PC.
  • Only Windows/PC achievement titles and locally matched Xbox App installations are imported.
  • Local discovery reads MicrosoftGame.config from GDK packages and XboxGames folders.
  • The active title is first refreshed after 45 seconds, then every 5 seconds. Existing unlocks seed the cache silently; later unlocks trigger notifications.
RetroAchievements
  • In Settings → Advanced, enter the RetroAchievements username and Web API key, select Connect, then Import Library.
  • This is an API-only integration. It does not scan local emulators, ROMs, processes or game folders, and the API key is stored encrypted.
  • Polling runs only while a RetroAchievements config is selected. Existing unlocks seed the cache silently; later unlocks trigger notifications.
Ubisoft Connect (Official)
  • Watch folder: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Ubisoft Game Launcher\spool.
  • Runtime progress is read from <userId>\<productId>.spool, while schema/images are generated from %ProgramData%\Ubisoft\Ubisoft Game Launcher\cache\achievements.
  • Config generation starts only after both the local spool file and achievements archive are available. The schema is generated first, then the config.
  • Add the Ubisoft spool root manually in Settings → Folders. The app does not assume this path automatically.
EA Desktop (Official)
  • Watch folder: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Electronic Arts\EA Desktop\Logs.
  • Schema is generated from achievement sets logged by EA Desktop, while runtime progress is read from EADesktopVerbose.log.
  • Config generation starts only after EA Desktop has logged a full achievement set for that game. The schema is generated first, then the config.
  • Add the EA Desktop Logs root manually in Settings → Folders. The app does not assume this path automatically.
  • EA Desktop can rotate EADesktopVerbose.log into EADesktopVerbose.bak; the app reads both so achievement events are not lost across log rotation.
GOG Galaxy (Official)
  • Watch folder: %LOCALAPPDATA%\GOG.com\Galaxy\Applications.
  • Local product mapping is read from %ProgramData%\GOG.com\Galaxy\storage\galaxy-2.0.db, and runtime progress is read from Applications\<clientId>\Gameplay\<userId>\gameplay.db.
  • Config generation starts only after gameplay.db exists and its achievement data is populated and stable. The schema is generated first, then the config.
  • If a game only has Storage data and no Gameplay\<userId>\gameplay.db yet, the watcher waits and retries automatically.
Xenia
  • Watch the Xenia content/profile path where .gpd files are updated.
  • Auto-config reads title data, generates schema/images, and starts notification flow from those files.
RPCS3
  • Watch trophy root: dev_hdd0\home\<user>\trophy.
  • Runtime updates are detected from TROPUSR.DAT and TROPCONF.SFM.
PS4 (shadPS4)
  • Watch folder: %APPDATA%\shadPS4.
  • Modern schema and icons are read from trophy\<NPWR>\Xml and trophy\<NPWR>\Icons; user progress is read from home\<userId>\trophy\<NPWR>.xml.
  • Legacy game_data\<CUSA>\TrophyFiles layouts remain supported, but the modern trophy and user progress layout is preferred.
Dead Space 2 MarkerPatch
  • Add the game directory containing deadspace2.exe, MarkerPatch.ini and the mod's achievements resources in Settings → Folders.
  • Schema and images come from the mod. Unlocks are read from %LOCALAPPDATA%\EA Games\Dead Space 2\settings.txt using Controls.AcL.X and Controls.AcL.Y as one bitflag.
  • Only unlock state is supported. If the state file does not exist yet, the adaptive watcher attaches after the mod creates it.
Alice: Madness Returns MadnessPatch
  • Add either the game root or its Binaries\Win32 directory containing MadnessPatch.ini and the mod achievement resources.
  • Per-profile unlock flags are read from Documents\My Games\Alice Madness Returns\AliceGame\CheckPoint\<profile>\Achievements.txt.
  • Missing profile files are attached adaptively and each profile keeps an independent baseline. AchievementSupport must remain enabled in MadnessPatch.ini.
XLiveLessNess
  • Add the game directory containing xlive.dll, <game>.exe and its matching <game>.exe.cfg. Metadata and images are read asynchronously from the executable's SPAFILE.
  • The generated config stores the detected executable and process names for launch, auto-select and playtime.
  • Global, game-local and custom XLiveLessNess state roots are monitored adaptively; -xllnconfig is also resolved when process arguments are available.
  • The config can be generated before achievements.dat exists. Profiles keep independent baselines so profile changes do not create false unlock notifications.
LumaPlay
  • Enable Settings → Folders → Enable LumaPlay Watcher.
  • Windows only: the app listens for realtime registry events under HKCU\SOFTWARE\LumaPlay.
  • The watcher starts only when enabled; if disabled, no LumaPlay registry watcher process is started.
  • LumaPlay configs are expected as platform=uplay and emu=lumaplay.
AppID and config rules
  • Steam/Uplay/GOG/Steam Official use regular app IDs; Epic may use numeric or hex-like IDs.
  • Xenia title IDs are hex and can be provided with or without the 0x prefix.
  • RPCS3 expects trophy-set IDs in NP* format (example: NPWR12345_00).
  • shadPS4 expects CUSA IDs (example: CUSA12345).
  • LumaPlay config detection requires platform=uplay and emu=lumaplay.
Rescan vs Regenerate Schema
  • Regenerate Schema is used for Steam/Uplay/Epic/GOG schema refresh.
  • For Xenia, RPCS3, shadPS4, Steam Official, Ubisoft Connect (Official), EA Desktop (Official) and GOG Galaxy (Official), schema regenerate is blocked by design.
  • For those platforms/emulators, use Folders → Rescan to rebuild from source files.
Boot onboarding and startup gate
  • On first run (or onboarding version change), startup waits for folder selection before full scanning.
  • While onboarding is pending, folder watchers are deferred to avoid unwanted auto-config activity.
  • Reminder messages are emitted periodically (about every 20s by default) until a decision is made.
  • Tray action Resume Startup applies skip-all and mutes all discovered folders for auto-config.
Filters and notification toggles
  • Ignored folders are stored as blocked watched folders and are not scanned.
  • Blacklisted AppIDs are skipped by auto-config and blocked for schema operations.
  • Disable Global Progress and per-game progress mute affect progress notifications only.
  • Disable Playtime and Disable Platinum control only their dedicated notification types.
Recovery and temp data
  • Missing watched folders are rechecked periodically (around 4 seconds).
  • When a missing folder reappears, watcher attach and follow-up scan are retried automatically.
  • Temporary single-root auto-config folders in OS Temp are cleaned automatically after generation.
Useful log tags
  • Watchers: watch-save, watch-save-strict-root, watch-lumaplay.
  • Startup flow: boot:onboarding:*.
  • Initial snapshot evaluation: initial-notify:*.
  • Auto selection flow: auto-select:*.
  • Steam Official handling: steam-official:*. Ubisoft Connect handling: ubisoft-official:*. EA Desktop handling: ea-official:*. Epic Official handling: epic-official:*. GOG Galaxy handling: gog-official:*.
Quick troubleshooting
  • Overlay and notifications work best in Borderless Windowed mode. DirectX 9/10/11 games usually require Borderless/Borderless Windowed mode for notifications to appear above the game. Fullscreen support is limited, but DirectX 12 games will usually work in Fullscreen when the game supports it.
  • Check that the game is not blacklisted and progress notifications are not muted globally/per-config.
  • Verify watched folder paths and confirm the save/trophy files actually change while playing.
  • After moving saves or emulator directories, run Rescan in Folders.
  • Match privilege level between app and game (non-admin/non-admin or admin/admin) for reliable overlay shortcuts.
  • If overlay hotkeys are blocked in a game, switch to a 3-key combination and avoid commonly intercepted keys.
  • In elevated/protected game contexts, drag may fail; use snap positions (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+1..5) or nudge mode (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Arrow Keys).
  • If PageUp/PageDown does not work in overlay, use the fallback Ctrl+PageUp / Ctrl+PageDown.
  • If sound plays but notifications appear late, lower preset cost (blur/shadows/large transforms) and reduce notification duration.
  • If overlay display/presentation issues appear, or the hotkey works but nothing is visible, toggle Disable Hardware Acceleration in Advanced > Rendering and restart the app. If issues remain, especially with Special K active, enable the globalShortcut compatibility option for overlay. This disables hook-based drag and can improve compatibility on some systems.
